items.cn: 希腊语 ēlektron 指琥珀。摩擦琥珀并看到它吸引轻小物体，是最早已知的电现象，于是这种材料把名字给了电。

items.en: Latin electrum kept both the amber sense and the sense of a pale gold-silver alloy; English electric came through Latin and French from this pair.
items.cn: 拉丁语 electrum 同时保留琥珀义与一种淡金色金银合金义；英语 electric 经拉丁语与法语由这一对词而来。

items.en: G. Johnstone Stoney proposed electron as the name of the unit of electric charge; the particle itself was later identified and kept the name.
items.cn: G·约翰斯通·斯通尼在 1891 年提出用 electron 作为电荷单位的名称；粒子本身后来被确认，也沿用了这个名字。

items.en: Electronic appeared in the early twentieth century for anything involving electrons, and then for devices that work by controlling them.
items.cn: electronic 在二十世纪初出现，指涉及电子的事物，随后指通过控制电子来运作的设备。

items.en: Valves, then transistors and chips, made electronic a household word for radios, calculators, records and later records in databases.
items.cn: 电子管、随后晶体管与芯片，使 electronic 成为收音机、计算器、唱片以及后来数据库记录的家常词。

items.en: The chain from Greek ēlektron, amber, through Latin electrum and the words for electric and electron to electronic is documented, and electron was named in 1891. The origin of ēlektron itself is disputed and the link to a Semitic amber word is a hypothesis; the earliest dates of the adjective are approximate.
items.cn: 首见年代不确定：从希腊语 ēlektron「琥珀」经拉丁语 electrum，再到「电的」「电子」两词，最后到该形容词，这条链有文献依据，电荷单位的名称于 1891 年由斯通尼造出；ēlektron 本身的来源有争议，与某闪米特语「琥珀」词的联系属于假说；形容词最早年代只有约数。

note.en: The first group is the electron family and the easily confused electric; the second group names neighbouring kinds of modern equipment and data.
note.cn: 第一组是电子词族与易混的 electric；第二组是相邻的现代设备与数据类别。

entries.definition: The negatively charged particle itself; electronic is the adjective describing what works by means of it.
entries.definitionCN: 指带负电的粒子本身；electronic 是描述依靠它运作的形容词。

entries.definition: The branch of technology, or the devices collectively; electronic is the adjective, not the field.
entries.definitionCN: 指技术分支或器件的总称；electronic 是形容词，不是学科名。

entries.definition: By electronic means; it answers how, while electronic answers what kind.
entries.definitionCN: 以电子方式；副词回答「怎样」，electronic 回答「哪一类」。

entries.definition: Working by electricity, especially mains power and motors; electronic is the finer sense of circuits that process signals.
entries.definitionCN: 以电力运作，尤指市电与电动机；electronic 是处理信号的电路这种更细的意义。

entries.definition: Expressed in discrete numbers; electronic describes the hardware, digital describes the form of the information.
entries.definitionCN: 用离散数字表示；electronic 描述硬件，digital 描述信息的形态。

entries.definition: Run or managed by computers; it stresses control, while electronic stresses the circuits themselves.
entries.definitionCN: 由计算机运行或管理；强调控制，electronic 强调电路本身。

entries.definition: Working without human operation; an electronic device may still need a person to set it.
entries.definitionCN: 无需人操作即可工作；电子设备仍可能需要人来设定。

entries.definition: Relating to electricity as power; electronic work is the low-power side that carries and processes information.
entries.definitionCN: 与作为动力的电有关；电子工作是承载与处理信息的低功率一侧。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real amber origin, the real particle and the real product phrases, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的琥珀来源、真实的粒子与真实的产品搭配，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Amber rubbed with cloth attracts dust; Greek called amber ēlektron, and the force took the material's name.
normal.cn: 琥珀与布摩擦会吸起碎屑；希腊语称琥珀为 ēlektron，电就随了这种材料的名字。

normal.en: The family runs electron, electronic, electronics, electronically and microelectronics.
normal.cn: 同族词有 electron、electronic、electronics、electronically 与 microelectronics。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the products: electronic device, electronic mail, electronic records.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出产品：电子设备、电子邮件、电子记录。

normal.en: Electric and electronic differ: a heater is electric, a calculator is electronic.
normal.cn: electric 与 electronic 有别：电暖器是 electric，计算器是 electronic。

normal.en: The adjective often means simply paperless: electronic records are data, not paper.
normal.cn: 这个形容词常只表示无纸：电子记录是数据，不是纸。

abstract.en: Picture a piece of amber holding a scrap of straw without a hand.
abstract.cn: 想象一块琥珀不用手就吸住一根草屑。

abstract.en: Picture a green board where tiny roads blink in a rhythm.
abstract.cn: 想象一块绿色板子，细小道路按节律闪烁。

abstract.en: Picture a form that no longer needs a desk to exist on.
abstract.cn: 想象一张表单不再需要一张桌子来存在。

examples.en: Electronic keys are harder to copy than metal ones.
examples.cn: 电子钥匙比金属钥匙更难复制。

examples.en: The journal moved to electronic publication only.
examples.cn: 这份期刊改为只出电子版。

examples.en: Electronic music was once made with rooms full of equipment.
examples.cn: 电子音乐曾要用装满整间屋子的设备来制作。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「一（e）勒（lek）壳（tro）你（nic）」——一勒壳就通电的粒子，就是电子式的

root: 希腊 ēlektron「琥珀」→ 拉丁 electrum → 英语 electric「电的」；1891 年以 electron 名电子，再加 -ic 构成 electronic「电子的」。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses start at the particle, move to circuits, paperless data, communication, music, engineering design, military signals and automated surveillance.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从粒子出发，走到电路、无纸数据、通信、音乐、工程设计、军事信号与自动监控。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a green circuit board with fine copper roads and rows of small parts, one lamp blinking.
core.cn: 核心意象：一块绿色电路板，细铜线连着成排小元件，一盏灯在闪。

branches.en: THE PARTICLE: the root sense, still used in physics for electron behaviour.
branches.cn: 粒子：词根义，物理学里仍指电子行为。

branches.en: HARDWARE: devices that control electron flow, and the design branch that builds their circuits.
branches.cn: 硬件：控制电子流的设备，以及构建其电路的设计分支。

branches.en: DATA AND MESSAGES: paperless records and electronic mail are information carried by circuits.
branches.cn: 数据与消息：无纸记录与电子邮件都是由电路承载的信息。

branches.en: ART: sound and image shaped by equipment rather than by acoustic bodies.
branches.cn: 艺术：由设备而非发声体塑造的声音与图像。

branches.en: CONTROL: signals used to jam an enemy or to watch a person.
branches.cn: 控制：用来干扰敌人或监视个人的信号。

intro.en: Electronic is a Greek-derived noun with a Latinised Greek adjective ending; the family later added -ics and -ally.
intro.cn: electronic 是希腊来源名词加拉丁化的希腊形容词词尾；词族后来又加 -ics 与 -ally。

latinIntro.en: Latin electrum is the bridge for the amber sense; the ending -ic is Greek -ikos in its Latin form.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 electrum 是琥珀义的桥接形式；词尾 -ic 是希腊语 -ikos 的拉丁形态。

items.example: The material named the force it revealed.
items.exampleCN: 这种材料给它所显现的力命了名。

items.example: Latin carried the word into European science.
items.exampleCN: 拉丁语把这个词带进欧洲科学。

items.example: Electric named the force before the particle was known.
items.exampleCN: 在粒子被发现之前，electric 已为这种力命名。

items.example: Stoney coined electron in 1891.
items.exampleCN: 斯通尼在 1891 年造出 electron。

items.example: The adjective first described electron physics.
items.exampleCN: 这个形容词最初描述电子物理。

items.example: Electronics names the field and its products.
items.exampleCN: electronics 指该领域及其产品。

items.example: The combining form builds microelectronics and optoelectronics.
items.exampleCN: 这个组合形式构成微电子学与光电子学。

items.example: Electronically means by electronic means.
items.exampleCN: electronically 意为以电子方式。

items.example: The ending later produced proton and neutron.
items.exampleCN: 这个词尾后来造出质子与中子。

definition_zh: 电子学；电子器件；电子电路
definition_en: the branch of technology dealing with electron flow and circuits, or the devices built from them
core_image: 工作台上摊开一块拆下的电路板，旁边是万用表与散落的电阻
scene: 工作台上摊着一块拆开的电路板，旁边是万用表与散落的电阻，屏幕显示着电压读数。The fault was in the electronics, not in the motor.
sceneCN: 这里 electronics 指设备内部的电子电路部分（第 3 个义项：设备内部的电子电路）；句意：故障在电子电路部分，不在电动机。图中可辨识物件：拆开的电路板、万用表、电阻、电压读数。

senses.title: The branch of technology
senses.definition: the field that studies and designs circuits in which electrons carry and control signals
senses.definitionCN: 研究并设计由电子承载与控制信号的电路的领域
senses.example: Electronics began with valves and grew into chips.
senses.exampleCN: 电子学从电子管开始，长成了芯片。
senses.why: the -ics ending marks a discipline, so the plainest sense is the field itself, parallel to physics or economics.
senses.whyCN: 词尾 -ics 标记学科，最基本的意思就是这门领域本身，与物理学、经济学同构。

senses.title: Electronic devices collectively
senses.definition: the products and components that work by electronic circuits
senses.definitionCN: 靠电子电路工作的产品与元件
senses.example: The shop sells electronics and small appliances.
senses.exampleCN: 这家店卖电子产品和厨房小电器。
senses.why: a field's name easily transfers to its products, and shops made that transfer permanent.
senses.whyCN: 领域名很容易转到产品上，商店让这一转移固定下来。

senses.title: The circuits inside a device
senses.definition: the internal electronic parts of a machine, considered as a subsystem
senses.definitionCN: 机器内部被当作一个子系统的电子部件
senses.example: The fault was in the electronics, not in the motor.
senses.exampleCN: 故障在电子电路部分，不在电动机。
senses.why: repair work separates mechanical parts from circuit boards, and the plural noun names the circuit side.
senses.whyCN: 维修工作把机械部件与电路板分开，复数名词就指电路那一侧。

senses.title: The industry
senses.definition: the sector that designs, makes and sells electronic goods and components
senses.definitionCN: 设计、制造并出售电子商品与元件的行业
senses.example: Electronics employs more people here than mining does.
senses.exampleCN: 电子产业在这里雇的人比矿业多。
senses.why: a discipline that becomes a business is named by the same word in economic writing.
senses.whyCN: 学科一旦成为生意，经济写作里就用同一个词命名。

senses.title: A hobby or practical skill
senses.definition: the activity of building and repairing circuits for interest
senses.definitionCN: 出于兴趣搭建与修理电路的活动
senses.example: He learned electronics from a box of old radios.
senses.exampleCN: 他从一箱旧收音机里学会了电子技术。
senses.why: the field has a hands-on version practised outside work, and hobby writing uses the plural name.
senses.whyCN: 这个领域有在工作之外的动手版本，爱好者写作就用这个复数名。

senses.title: The consumer category
senses.definition: the class of household and personal devices sold to the public
senses.definitionCN: 面向公众出售的家用与个人设备类别
senses.example: Consumer electronics dominates the holiday sales figures.
senses.exampleCN: 消费电子产品在节日销售数据中占主导。
senses.why: retail needed a label for the goods on its shelves and shortened the field name into a category.
senses.whyCN: 零售需要给货架上的商品一个标签，就把领域名缩成类别名。

senses.title: A school or college subject
senses.definition: a course teaching circuit theory and practical building
senses.definitionCN: 教授电路理论与实际搭建的课程
senses.example: Electronics is taught in the same department as physics.
senses.exampleCN: 电子学与物理在同一系里教授。
senses.why: technical education turned the field into a timetable slot, using the discipline sense unchanged.
senses.whyCN: 技术教育把领域变成课表上的一格，沿用不变的学科义。

senses.title: The parts that can fail
senses.definition: the electronic components of a system, spoken of as the likely source of breakdown
senses.definitionCN: 系统中的电子部件，被视为故障的常见来源
senses.example: Salt air had eaten the electronics within a year.
senses.exampleCN: 盐雾一年之内就腐蚀了电子部件。
senses.why: in maintenance talk, the plural noun is a shorthand for the fragile, replaceable half of a machine.
senses.whyCN: 在维修语境里，这个复数名词是机器脆弱、可更换那一半的简称。

intro.en: Electronics is electronic plus the field ending -ics, modelled on physics. Its root is Greek ēlektron, amber. The field name is early twentieth-century. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: electronics 是 electronic 加学科词尾 -ics，仿 physics 构成。词根是希腊语 ēlektron「琥珀」。学科名产生于二十世纪初。年代均为约数。

items.en: Ēlektron meant amber, the material whose rubbed surface first revealed electric attraction; the force took the material's name.
items.cn: ēlektron 指琥珀，这种材料被摩擦后的表面最早显现电吸引；电因此随了材料的名字。

items.en: Electron was coined in 1891 for the charge unit, and electronic followed for anything involving electrons.
items.cn: electron 在 1891 年被造为电荷单位之名，electronic 随后指涉及电子的事物。

items.en: English names fields with -ics, as in physics, optics and economics; electronics follows that pattern rather than inventing a new ending.
items.cn: 英语用 -ics 命名学科，如物理学、光学、经济学；electronics 遵循这一模式，没有另造词尾。

items.en: Electronics named the new branch that dealt with valves and electron tubes, distinct from heavy electrical engineering.
items.cn: electronics 命名了处理电子管的新分支，与重型电气工程相区别。

items.en: After the transistor, the word widened to circuits in general and then to the products containing them.
items.cn: 晶体管之后，这个词扩展到泛指电路，又扩展到含有电路的产物。

items.en: The word is the adjective plus the field ending -ics, a documented pattern also seen in physics and economics. The origin of ēlektron is disputed and the Semitic amber link is a hypothesis; the earliest dates of the field name are approximate.
items.cn: 首见年代不确定：该词由形容词加学科词尾构成，这一模式在物理学、经济学中同样有文献依据；ēlektron 的来源有争议，与闪米特语「琥珀」词的联系属于假说；学科名最早年代只有约数。

note.en: The first group is the same family in singular and personal forms; the second group names neighbouring branches and collections of equipment.
note.cn: 第一组是同一词族的单数形式与人称形式；第二组是相邻分支与设备集合。

entries.definition: The adjective describing devices or data; electronics is the field or the devices taken together.
entries.definitionCN: 描述设备或数据的形容词；electronics 指领域或设备总称。

entries.definition: The particle whose flow the field controls; electronics is the practice built around it.
entries.definitionCN: 该领域所控制其流动的粒子；electronics 是围绕它建立的实践。

entries.definition: A person who designs circuits; the field name plus a job noun, not a new discipline.
entries.definitionCN: 设计电路的人；是领域名加职业名词，不是新学科。

entries.definition: A tradesperson who installs wiring and power systems; an electronics engineer works with signals, not mains wiring.
entries.definitionCN: 安装布线与时电力系统的技工；电子工程师处理信号，不处理市电布线。

entries.definition: The broad engineering field covering power generation, motors and wiring; electronics is its low-power signal branch.
entries.definitionCN: 涵盖发电、电动机与布线的宽工程领域；electronics 是其中低功率的信号分支。

entries.definition: The circuits of a device taken as a body; close to one sense of electronics, but it names the wiring rather than the discipline.
entries.definitionCN: 一台设备的电路总体；接近 electronics 的一义，但指线路而非学科。

entries.definition: The physical parts of a computer; electronics is the circuit technology, hardware is the assembled equipment.
entries.definitionCN: 计算机的实体部件；electronics 是电路技术，hardware 是装好的设备。

entries.definition: The electrical wiring and power system of a building or vehicle; it is power, not signal processing.
entries.definitionCN: 建筑或车辆的布线供电系统；是电力，不是信号处理。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real amber root, the real -ics pattern and the real product phrases, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的琥珀词根、真实的 -ics 模式与真实的产品搭配，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Electronics is electronic plus -ics, the same way physics names a field.
normal.cn: electronics 是 electronic 加 -ics，与物理学命名领域的方式相同。

normal.en: The family runs electronics, electronic, electron, electronically and microelectronics.
normal.cn: 同族词有 electronics、electronic、electron、electronically 与 microelectronics。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the field and the shelf: power electronics, consumer electronics, electronics industry.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出领域与货架：电力电子学、消费电子、电子产业。

normal.en: The root is amber, so an old piece of jewelry hides inside a modern word.
normal.cn: 词根是琥珀，所以一块旧首饰藏在现代词里。

normal.en: When a mechanic says the electronics failed, the word means the circuit boards.
normal.cn: 当技师说电子部分坏了，这个词指的就是电路板。

abstract.en: Picture a board of tiny roads where traffic is made of charge.
abstract.cn: 想象一块细小道路的板子，上面的车流由电荷组成。

abstract.en: Picture a shelf of devices that all trace their name to a stone.
abstract.cn: 想象一货架设备，名字都追到一块石头上。

abstract.en: Picture a broken radio whose silence comes from one cold joint.
abstract.cn: 想象一台坏收音机，沉默只来自一个冷焊点。

examples.en: Power electronics makes electric cars quieter and more efficient.
examples.cn: 电力电子学让电动车更安静、更高效。

examples.en: The electronics in that old camera cannot be replaced.
examples.cn: 那台旧相机的电子部件已无法更换。

examples.en: She studied electronics before switching to software.
examples.cn: 她在转到软件之前学的是电子学。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「一（e）勒（lek）壳（tro）你（ni）壳（cs）」——一勒壳就通电的一门学问，就是电子学

root: 希腊 ēlektron「琥珀」→ 拉丁 electrum → electric → electron（1891）+ -ic → electronic；再加学科词尾 -ics 构成 electronics。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses move from the discipline to devices as products, the circuits inside a machine, the industry, a hobby, a retail category, a school subject and the parts that fail.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从学科走到作为产品的器件、机器内电路、产业、业余爱好、零售类别、学校科目，最后走到会坏的那部分。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an opened circuit board on a bench, a multimeter beside it and voltage numbers on screen.
core.cn: 核心意象：工作台上拆开的电路板，旁边一只万用表，屏幕上是电压读数。

branches.en: THE FIELD: the discipline as research and as a taught subject.
branches.cn: 领域：作为研究与教学科目的学科。

branches.en: GOODS: devices as products, including the retail category on the shelf.
branches.cn: 商品：作为产品的器件，包括货架上的零售类别。

branches.en: INSIDE THE MACHINE: the circuit subsystem, especially when it is the suspected fault.
branches.cn: 机器内部：电路子系统，尤其当它被怀疑出故障时。

branches.en: BUSINESS: the sector that designs, builds and sells the goods.
branches.cn: 产业：设计、制造并出售这些商品的部门。

branches.en: CRAFT: building and repairing circuits for interest rather than employment.
branches.cn: 手艺：出于兴趣而非受雇搭建与修理电路。

intro.en: Electronics is a Greek-derived stem with a Greek field ending, both filtered through Latin and French before English.
intro.cn: electronics 是希腊来源词干加希腊学科词尾，两者都经拉丁语与法语过滤后才进入英语。

latinIntro.en: Latin electrum carried the amber sense; the field ending -ics is Greek and has no Latin ancestor of its own.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 electrum 承载琥珀义；学科词尾 -ics 是希腊语，本身没有拉丁语祖先。

items.example: The material supplied the root of the whole family.
items.exampleCN: 这种材料提供了整个词族的词根。

items.example: Latin carried the root into scientific vocabulary.
items.exampleCN: 拉丁语把词根带进科学词汇。

items.example: The particle name supplied the stem.
items.exampleCN: 粒子名为学科名提供词干。

items.example: The adjective describes devices and data.
items.exampleCN: 这个形容词描述设备与数据。

items.example: The ending turns an adjective into a discipline.
items.exampleCN: 这个词尾把形容词变成学科名。

items.example: The plural form takes a singular verb as a subject name.
items.exampleCN: 这个复数形式作学科名时接单数动词。
